reuse.why: Fintegra links through the shared linkBankSyncAccount/linkOrgBankSyncAccount helpers, the existing guardBankAccountLink wrapper, findOrCreateBank and the generalized downloadSyncServerTransactions, the same paths the other providers now use.

duplication.why: Rather than adding a sixth copy of the link function and a third copy of the sync-server download, it folds the five link copies and the Pluggy/Akahu download copies into shared helpers.

placement.why: Linking stays in accounts/app.ts, downloading in accounts/sync.ts, the URL in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, matching how the other providers are laid out.

scope.why: Refactoring all existing providers' link and download functions goes beyond adding Fintegra, but it serves the request directly by giving the new provider a shared path; the desktop-client edit is the minimal one the satisfies-check requires.

maintainability.why: Much less code to own and a clear provider-parameterised path; positional helper arguments and the remaining if/else provider dispatch in sync.ts still need touching for each provider.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The Fintegra handler uses guardBankAccountLink, findOrCreateBank and the new shared link and download helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: Copies were removed into shared helpers; the remaining institution-name block in linkEnableBankingAccount is pre-existing and reduced, not reshaped.
